479 LadyDeathwhisperGUID = creature->GetGUID();
480 break;
481 case NPC_DEATHBRINGER_SAURFANG:
482 DeathbringerSaurfangGUID = creature->GetGUID();
483 break;
484 case NPC_SE_HIGH_OVERLORD_SAURFANG:
485 // Only the static spawn is the event NPC - the Alliance outro summons another
486 // High Overlord Saurfang, which would otherwise clobber the guid.
487 if (creature->IsSummon())
488 break;
489
490 if (GetTeamIdInInstance() == TEAM_ALLIANCE)
491 {
492 creature->UpdateEntry(NPC_SE_MURADIN_BRONZEBEARD, true);
493 creature->LoadEquipment();
494 }
495 DeathbringerSaurfangEventGUID = creature->GetGUID();
496 creature->LastUsedScriptID = creature->GetScriptId();
497 HideSaurfangEventNpc(creature);
498 break;
499 case NPC_SE_MURADIN_BRONZEBEARD:
500 if (creature->IsSummon())
501 break;
502
503 DeathbringerSaurfangEventGUID = creature->GetGUID();
504 HideSaurfangEventNpc(creature);
505 break;
506 case NPC_HIGH_OVERLORD_SAURFANG_DUMMY:
507 if (GetTeamIdInInstance() == TEAM_ALLIANCE)
508 {
509 creature->UpdateEntry(NPC_MURADIN_BRONZEBEARD_DUMMY, creature->GetCreatureData());
510 creature->LoadEquipment();
511 }
512 break;
513 case NPC_SE_KOR_KRON_REAVER:
514 if (creature->IsSummon())
515 break;
516
517 if (GetTeamIdInInstance() == TEAM_ALLIANCE)
518 creature->UpdateEntry(NPC_SE_SKYBREAKER_MARINE);
519 SaurfangEventGuardGUIDs.push_back(creature->GetGUID());
520 HideSaurfangEventNpc(creature);
521 break;
522 case NPC_FESTERGUT:
523 FestergutGUID = creature->GetGUID();
524 break;
525 case NPC_ROTFACE:
526 RotfaceGUID = creature->GetGUID();
527 break;
528 case NPC_PROFESSOR_PUTRICIDE:
529 ProfessorPutricideGUID = creature->GetGUID();
530 if (GetBossState(DATA_ROTFACE) == DONE && GetBossState(DATA_FESTERGUT) == DONE && !HeroicAttempts && GetData(DATA_HAS_LIMITED_ATTEMPTS) && creature->IsAlive())
531 creature->SetVisible(false);
532 break;
533 case NPC_PRINCE_KELESETH:
534 BloodCouncilGUIDs[0] = creature->GetGUID();
535 break;
536 case NPC_PRINCE_TALDARAM:
537 BloodCouncilGUIDs[1] = creature->GetGUID();
538 break;
539 case NPC_PRINCE_VALANAR:
540 BloodCouncilGUIDs[2] = creature->GetGUID();
541 break;
542 case NPC_BLOOD_ORB_CONTROLLER:
543 BloodCouncilControllerGUID = creature->GetGUID();
544 break;
545 case NPC_BLOOD_QUEEN_LANA_THEL:
546 BloodQueenLanaThelGUID = creature->GetGUID();
547 if (!HeroicAttempts && GetData(DATA_HAS_LIMITED_ATTEMPTS) && creature->IsAlive())
548 creature->SetVisible(false);
549 break;
550 case NPC_CROK_SCOURGEBANE:
551 CrokScourgebaneGUID = creature->GetGUID();
552 break;
553 // we can only do this because there are no gaps in their entries
554 case NPC_CAPTAIN_ARNATH:
555 case NPC_CAPTAIN_BRANDON:
556 case NPC_CAPTAIN_GRONDEL:
557 case NPC_CAPTAIN_RUPERT:
558 CrokCaptainGUIDs[creature->GetEntry() - NPC_CAPTAIN_ARNATH] = creature->GetGUID();
559 break;
560 case NPC_SISTER_SVALNA:
561 SisterSvalnaGUID = creature->GetGUID();
562 break;
563 case NPC_VALITHRIA_DREAMWALKER:
564 ValithriaDreamwalkerGUID = creature->GetGUID();
565 break;
566 case NPC_THE_LICH_KING_VALITHRIA:
567 ValithriaLichKingGUID = creature->GetGUID();
568 break;
569 case NPC_THE_LICH_KING_LH:
570 TheLichKingLhGUID = creature->GetGUID();
571 break;
572 case NPC_GREEN_DRAGON_COMBAT_TRIGGER:
573 ValithriaTriggerGUID = creature->GetGUID();
574 break;
575 case NPC_PUTRICADES_TRAP:
576 PutricadeTrapGUID = creature->GetGUID();
577 break;
578 case NPC_SINDRAGOSA_GAUNTLET:
579 SindragosaGauntletGUID = creature->GetGUID();
580 break;
581 case NPC_SINDRAGOSA:
582 SindragosaGUID = creature->GetGUID();
583 if (!HeroicAttempts && GetData(DATA_HAS_LIMITED_ATTEMPTS) && creature->IsAlive())
584 creature->SetVisible(false);
585 break;
586 case NPC_SPINESTALKER:
587 SpinestalkerGUID = creature->GetGUID();
588 break;
589 case NPC_RIMEFANG:
590 RimefangGUID = creature->GetGUID();
591 break;
592 case NPC_INVISIBLE_STALKER:
593 // Teleporter visual at center
594 if (creature->GetExactDist2d(4357.052f, 2769.421f) < 10.0f && GetBossState(DATA_PROFESSOR_PUTRICIDE) == DONE && GetBossState(DATA_BLOOD_QUEEN_LANA_THEL) == DONE && GetBossState(DATA_SINDRAGOSA) == DONE)
595 creature->CastSpell(creature, SPELL_ARTHAS_TELEPORTER_CEREMONY, false);
596 break;
597 case NPC_THE_LICH_KING:
598 TheLichKingGUID = creature->GetGUID();
599 if (!HeroicAttempts && GetData(DATA_HAS_LIMITED_ATTEMPTS) && creature->IsAlive())
600 creature->SetVisible(false);
601 break;
602 case NPC_HIGHLORD_TIRION_FORDRING_LK:
603 HighlordTirionFordringGUID = creature->GetGUID();
604 break;
605 case NPC_TERENAS_MENETHIL_FROSTMOURNE:
606 case NPC_TERENAS_MENETHIL_FROSTMOURNE_H:
607 TerenasMenethilGUID = creature->GetGUID();
608 break;
609 case NPC_INFILTRATOR_MINCHAR_BQ:
610 if (BloodQuickeningState == DONE)
611 creature->DespawnOrUnsummon(1ms);
612 break;
613 case NPC_MINCHAR_BEAM_STALKER:
614 if (BloodQuickeningState != DONE)
615 {
616 uint32 spellId = 0;
617 if (creature->GetPositionY() > 2790.0f && creature->GetPositionZ() > 420.0f)
618 spellId = BLOOD_BEAM_VISUAL_RHAND;
619 else if (creature->GetPositionY() < 2790.0f && creature->GetPositionZ() > 420.0f)
620 spellId = BLOOD_BEAM_VISUAL_LHAND;
621 else if (creature->GetPositionY() < 2790.0f && creature->GetPositionZ() < 420.0f)
622 spellId = BLOOD_BEAM_VISUAL_LLEG;
623 else
624 spellId = BLOOD_BEAM_VISUAL_RLEG;
625 creature->m_Events.AddEventAtOffset(new DelayedCastMincharEvent(creature, spellId), 1s);
626 }
627 break;
628 case NPC_SKYBREAKER_DECKHAND:
629 case NPC_ORGRIMS_HAMMER_CREW:
630 if (!creature->IsAlive())
631 creature->Respawn();
632 break;
633 default:
634 break;
635 }
636
637 InstanceScript::OnCreatureCreate(creature);
638
639 }
